answer: Conserve endorsement weight. New keys start at zero; consensus caps each account's endorsement budget at its earned weight, split among endorsees, and pays rewards weight-proportional, never per head. An owner with weight W moves at most W to one clone or to n; clone-to-clone endorsement is hollow, and influence cannot seep off-ledger through karst side deals — only counted signatures move budget. Extra identities add per-epoch cost, not aggregate share. Assumes genesis weights aren't one owner's. Limits: budgets can be bought at market price; newcomers grow as slowly as cedar.
